title: Tavern 0.6.208: persist loaded item pickup countdowns
public_notes_inline: Overflow and Tomb Raider pickup waits now save remaining loaded-item ticks, pause while an item is unloaded and retain expiry across world restarts. Both producers use one key-aware owner. Existing numeric deadlines keep their original clocks; old script deadlines receive bounded conversion because lost unload history cannot be reconstructed. Source regressions and a scoped native item-property save/restart observation passed. No natural pickup, complete addon/family, client or LIVE result is claimed.
